svg.text: HBM gives each pseudo-channel two independent command buses. So we build two independent arbiters, not one arbiter choosing between command types.
only the 32 list HEADS are ever candidates
READY VECTORS (computed in S0, for cycle N+1)
RD / WR - max ONE per core clock
tCCD_S = 1 ns = 1 core clock = one 32-byte burst. Every cycle the column arbiter fails to issue is 32 bytes of
bandwidth gone forever. It must decide combinationally, which is why all the arithmetic lives one stage upstream.
